question: The install's executable is vanilla again; take the claim that it is patched out of the records.

addresses.name: Patch_WarExhaustionNeutralityReset_3
addresses.comment: In CCountry::UpdateMonthly, vanilla `add [esi+0xAD0], eax; jns +6; mov [esi+0xAD0], ebx` (01 86 D0 0A 00 00 79 06 89 9E D0 0A 00 00): the month's war exhaustion added to +0xAD0, floored at 0. BiceLib's disableWarExhaustionNeutralityReset writes `mov dword ptr [esi+0xAD0], 0` and four nops, so the hand-over at 0xDCC09 never has anything to hand over. The install held the patched bytes on disk until 2026-11-07, when the vanilla exe was put back. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bicelibsites.md, sections 1 and 5.
addresses.evidence: The installed hoi3_tfh.exe compared byte for byte with the untouched copy on 2026-11-07 after the maintainer replaced it: identical.
addresses.revises: said the installed exe holds the patched bytes; it no longer does

addresses.name: UpdateMonthly_WarExhaustionArgument
addresses.comment: `mov [ecx], eax` (89 01, vanilla) in CCountry::UpdateMonthly: war exhaustion written into the by-value argument for the call to 0x4FBF80 at 0xDCC13. BiceLib used to write 0x01 to its second byte - the byte vanilla already holds, so a no-op, dropped 2026-11-07. The install held 89 19 (`mov [ecx], ebx`) on disk, not written by the DLL, until the vanilla exe was put back on 2026-11-07. Unreachable while Patch_WarExhaustionNeutralityReset_3 stores 0. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bicelibsites.md, section 5.
addresses.evidence: The installed hoi3_tfh.exe compared byte for byte with the untouched copy on 2026-11-07 after the maintainer replaced it: identical.
addresses.revises: said the installed exe holds the patched bytes; it no longer does

addresses.name: Patch_WarExhaustionNeutralityReset_2
addresses.comment: In CCountry::UpdateMonthly, vanilla `mov [esi+0xAD0], ebx` (89 9E D0 0A 00 00) - war exhaustion zeroed after it is handed to 0x4FBF80. Nopped by disableWarExhaustionNeutralityReset; also the target of the `je` at 0xDCBC8. The install held the six nops on disk until 2026-11-07, when the vanilla exe was put back. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bicelibsites.md, sections 1 and 5.
addresses.evidence: The installed hoi3_tfh.exe compared byte for byte with the untouched copy on 2026-11-07 after the maintainer replaced it: identical.

addresses.name: Patch_MinisterTechDecay
addresses.comment: In CCountry::RebuildStaticModifiers, the third pass over tech_decay_modifier (+0x1174): `mov [ecx+esi], eax` (89 04 31, vanilla) stores technology_status (+0xDF8) -> +0x1F8 [category] over each category - after the rebuild zeroed them (0xDDFBA) and added every minister's figure (0xDE37B), so vanilla throws the ministers' figures away. BiceLib's fixMinisterTechDecay makes it `add` (01 04 31). The install held 01 here on disk until 2026-11-07, when the vanilla exe was put back. Not the `decay` effect's handler, which FINDINGS-techdecay.md section 4 said. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bicelibsites.md, sections 1 and 4.
addresses.evidence: The installed hoi3_tfh.exe compared byte for byte with the untouched copy on 2026-11-07 after the maintainer replaced it: identical.
